name: WebsitePusher
author: WebsitePusher
description: Push your local WordPress changes to your live site safely. Automatic backups before every update, instant undo, and plain English controls built for non developers.
changelog:
* Shows who on your team is working on this website, so two people don't change the same site at once. The WebsitePusher app checks a site out when someone starts and frees it when they're done.
* Remembers where the website's code lives on GitHub, so every teammate's app can find it.
* When a website stops being shared with a teammate, the app can give it a new connection code, so the old one stops working.
